title: Silent Hill: The Short Message
subtitle: A message draws Anita into an abandoned building
summary: Silent Hill: The Short Message is Konami and HexaDrive's short psychological horror game, released free for PlayStation 5 on 31 January 2024. Anita follows messages connected to her deceased friend Maya into the Villa, an abandoned apartment complex in a declining German town. Graffiti, remembered conversations and the building's changing spaces gradually expose the relationships behind the journey. Played in first person, the experience places the player close to Anita's uncertainty. There is no combat system to make the threat manageable through a weapon; the building must be explored and its pursuer escaped.
body: Silent Hill: The Short Message is Konami and HexaDrive's short psychological horror game, released free for PlayStation 5 on 31 January 2024. Anita follows messages connected to her deceased friend Maya into the Villa, an abandoned apartment complex in a declining German town. Graffiti, remembered conversations and the building's changing spaces gradually expose the relationships behind the journey. Played in first person, the experience places the player close to Anita's uncertainty. There is no combat system to make the threat manageable through a weapon; the building must be explored and its pursuer escaped.

Messages and calls carry information from beyond the room currently being explored, while Maya's artwork provides a trail through the Villa. The story addresses bullying, social-media comparison and the damage caused by isolation and jealousy. Pursuit sequences interrupt investigation with the immediate need to find a route away from a creature covered in cherry blossoms. The player alternates between reading the traces of relationships and moving under pressure. That contrast allows the same environment to operate as a place of memory during one passage and a confusing network of escape routes during another.

Motoi Okamoto directed the project, with music by returning Silent Hill composer Akira Yamaoka. Announced and released on the same day, it offered a new standalone encounter with the series without a purchase price. Reviews differed over the dialogue, repeated chases and handling of its themes, while often recognising the strength of the visual atmosphere. The Short Message gives Silent Hill a contemporary social context, using the intimacy of phone communication and the pressure of online visibility to connect its abandoned spaces to the emotional difficulties of the young characters moving through them.
story_headings: A message draws Anita into an abandoned building
The phone connects memory, comparison and fear
A small standalone release reopens the series
